<b>Benches</b> are [[Save Data (Silksong)/Save Points|save points]] throughout [[Pharloom]] that [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] can rest on to automatically:
* Save the game
* Respawn on the Bench after quitting the game or dying
* Replenish all health
* Replenish [[Silk]] slowly if [[Sylphsong]] has been acquired
* Replenish equipped {{CrestSlot|Red|s}} by spending [[Shell Shards]]<ref group="Note">Red Tools which don't require Shell Shards:
* [[Rosary Cannon]] (uses [[Rosaries]])
* [[Flea Brew]] (uses [[File:Icon SS Flea Brew Reserve.png|20x20px]] reserve)
* [[Plasmium Phial]] (uses [[File:Icon SS Plasmium Reserve.png|20x20px]] reserve)
* [[Needle Phial]] (must be used on enemies)
Note: Flea Brew costs {{S|10}} to repair a broken bottle.</ref>
* Replenish equipped {{CrestSlot|Blue|s}}<ref group="Note">Only affects [[Fractured Mask]], [[Reserve Bind]] and [[Wreath of Purity]].</ref>
* Remove [[Muckmaggot]] infestation, [[Plasmium Phial|Plasmium Masks]] and [[Plasmium Phial#Plasmification|plasmification]]
* Update the [[Map and Quill (Silksong)|Map]] with newly-explored rooms (if a [[Map and Quill (Silksong)|Quill]] has been acquired)
* Respawn defeated enemies (excluding enemies in the current room)
* Respawn broken [[Plasmium Cocoon]]s
* Refill depleted [[Silk#Silk Spindles|Silk Spindles]]
* Have a 30% chance of triggering the [[Skull Tyrant]] in [[Bone Bottom]]<ref group="Note">Can only occur after Hornet:
* Defeats the first [[Skull Tyrant]] in [[the Marrow]]
* Reaches either [[Blasted Steps]], [[Sinner's Road]] or [[the Citadel]], then rests at a Bench outside of [[Bone Bottom]] and the Marrow
* Finally rests on the Bench in Bone Bottom</ref>
* Have a 20–50% chance of triggering the [[Craw Summons]] during [[Act 3]]<ref group="Note">Can only occur after Hornet:
* Hits the lever inside the house on [[Craw Lake]]
* Completes the <i>[[SEEK: Awaiting the End]]</i> [[Objectives|objective]]
* Finally rests on a Bench in [[Bellhart]], [[Bilewater]], [[Far Fields]], [[Shellwood]], [[Sinner's Road]] or [[Wisp Thicket]]
The chance is initially 20%, increasing by 5% whenever Hornet acquires [[Silk Soar]], one of the four [[Old Hearts]] or the [[Everbloom]].</ref>

Hornet can also perform special actions in the [[Controls (Silksong)|INVENTORY]] menu while resting on a Bench:
* Change [[Crests]]
* Equip or unequip [[Tools]]
* Reload the [[Rosary Cannon]] by spending [[Rosaries]]
* Toggle the [[Voltvessels]] between Spear and Bola forms

== Locations and Prices ==
[[File:Mapshot SS Benches.png|thumb|Locations of all Benches in Pharloom]]

There are 84<ref group="Note">Special considerations:
* The double/triple Toll Benches in [[Underworks]] are counted as one Bench per room, as only one map marker appears for each.
* The rotten Bell Bench in Bilewater is not counted, as the Bench is not functional.
* On the map below, the two Benches at [[the Marrow]]'s [[Flea Caravan]] and [[Survivor's Camp]] overlap due to sharing the same spot in different [[Acts]].</ref> Benches across Pharloom, including temporary Benches like [[Shakra]]'s. Hornet can purchase a set of [[File:Icon SS Bench Pin.png|20x20px]] [[Map and Quill (Silksong)#Map Pins|Bench Pins]] from Shakra for {{R|60}}, which marks the locations of all discovered Benches on any acquired Maps.

=== Paid Benches ===
Many Benches require Rosaries to use.<ref><i>"A machine with a symbol of a bench."<br>"Insert Rosaries?"</i></ref> Bell Benches outside of [[Bellshrine]]s are permanently unlocked after a one-time fee, while the Toll Benches in [[Underworks]] charge a toll for every visit. If a Bench has a toll that has not been paid, or is unusable due to a trap, its [[File:Icon SS Bench Pin Grey.png|20x20px]] Bench Pin is greyed out.

== Bellshrines ==
There are six <b>Bellshrines</b> scattered across Pharloom. When activated by hitting a lever on the floor, a large mechanism swings the bell, ringing it four times before unlocking a permanent Bench. Activating the first five Bellshrines is necessary to complete the <i>[[Acts#Grand Gate|OPEN: Grand Gate]]</i> objective and fight the [[Last Judge]], as an entry point to [[Act 2]].

The first five Bellshrines are found in [[the Marrow]], [[Deep Docks]], [[Greymoor]], [[Bellhart]], [[Shellwood]]; the sixth is at [[Songclave]], called the "First Shrine", where it is used to summon [[Pilgrims]].

== Trivia ==
* Some Benches in [[Pharloom]] are primed with a trap, or require additional steps to be made functional:
** A Bench in northern [[Hunter's March]] has a pressure plate beneath it, activating a spike trap when Hornet sits on it. The trap can be deactivated by striking a hidden lever to the left, allowing the Bench to function normally.<ref>[[Gilly]]: <i>Ho, what clever traps the red-shells lay in defence of their lands! I've narrowly avoided a few nasty ends myself. It certainly adds a thrill to my investigations...</i></ref>
** A Bench in western [[Sinner's Road]] jams and fails to emerge fully after the Rosary toll is paid. It must be repaired by destroying the vines jamming the mechanism in a hidden room to the left.<ref>[[Shakra]]: <i>Do you see? How crass and frail that Citadel's machines! This one groans in pain at its very existence.</i></ref>
** A Bench in northern [[Bilewater]] collapses into a pit of [[muckmaggot]]-infested water when Hornet sits on it. This Bench cannot be made functional, and is no longer marked on the [[Map and Quill (Silksong)|Map]] after being broken.
* The tune that is played by the bells when activating a Bellshrine is the <i>Dies irae</i> melody, used extensively throughout the game's [[Soundtrack (Silksong)#Trivia|soundtrack]].
* The Bellshrine in [[Bellhart]] is the largest of all the Bellshrines, and is the only one with the bell set in a background layer, where Hornet is unable to hit it.
* Without skips, it is impossible to reach the <i>[[Acts#Grand Gate|OPEN: Grand Gate]]</i> objective without having rung any Bellshrines; even without the Needolin, the Marrow Bellshrine is still required to be rung in order to access [[Swift Step]], which is otherwise required to progress.
* While sitting at a bench, time does not pass for such purposes as the [[Crawbell]], or [[Styx]].
* In early pre-release footage of <i>Hollow Knight: Silksong</i>, bells in the Bellshrines would have a [[Seals|rune]] appear on them while ringing.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pFAknD_9U7c Hollow Knight: Silksong Reveal Trailer]</ref> This is very likely connected to the cut [[Strung to Serve]] ending.
* The paid bench in southwest [[Mount Fay]] produces a unique sound when its bells are rung, resembling sleigh bells.
